Shift 4 ⬡ (You may pay 4 ⬡ to play this on top of
one of your characters named Ariel.)
AMPLIFIED VOICE Whenever you play a song,
you may pay 2 ⬡ to deal 3 damage to chosen
character.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡（你可以支付 4 ⬡ 將這個角色打在你一個名為 Ariel 的角色上。）
擴音之聲　每當你打出一首歌時，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 對指定角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: Ariel - Determined Mermaid
en:
I WANT MORE Whenever you play a song, you
may draw a card, then choose and discard a card.
zh: 我想要更多　每當你打出一首歌時，你可以抽一張牌，然後選擇並棄掉一張卡。

name: One Last Hope
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. If a Hero character is chosen, they can also
challenge ready characters this turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。若選擇的是英雄角色，他們本回合還可以挑戰已準備的角色。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Smash
en: Deal 3 damage to chosen character.
zh: 對指定角色造成 3 點傷害。

name: I Find 'Em, I Flatten 'Em
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Banish all items.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
消滅所有物品。

name: Fire the Cannons!
en: Deal 2 damage to chosen character.
zh: 對指定角色造成 2 點傷害。

name: Strength of a Raging Fire
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this song
for free.)
Deal damage to chosen character equal to the number of
characters you have in play.
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對指定角色造成等同你在場角色數量的傷害。

name: The Mob Song
en:
Sing Together 10 (Any number of your or your
teammates' characters with total cost 10 or more may
⟳ to sing this song for free.)
Deal 3 damage to up to 3 chosen characters and/or
locations.
zh:
合唱 10（你或隊友的角色，任意數量、費用合計 10 或以上，可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
對至多 3 個指定角色和/或地點造成 3 點傷害。

name: Beast's Mirror
en:
SHOW ME ⟳, 3 ⬡ — If you have no cards in your hand,
draw a card.
zh: 給我看　⟳，3 ⬡ — 若你手上沒有卡，抽一張牌。

name: Maui's Place of Exile - Hidden Island
en:
ISOLATED Characters gain Resist +1 while here. (Damage dealt to them
is reduced by 1.)
zh: 與世隔絕　角色在這裡時獲得抵抗 +1。（對他們造成的傷害減少 1。）

name: The Queen - Conceited Ruler
en:
Support (Whenever this character quests, you may add
their ¤ to another chosen character's ¤ this turn.)
ROYAL SUMMONS At the start of your turn, you may
choose and discard a Princess or Queen character
card to return a character card from your discard to
your hand.
zh:
支援（每當這個角色探險時，你可以在本回合把其 ¤ 加到另一個指定角色的 ¤ 上。）
皇家召喚　在你的回合開始時，你可以選擇並棄掉一張公主或皇后角色卡，來將一張角色卡從棄牌堆移回你的手牌。

name: Aurora - Holding Court
en:
ROYAL WELCOME Whenever this character quests,
you pay 1 ⬡ less for the next Princess or Queen
character you play this turn.
zh: 皇家歡迎　每當這個角色探險時，你本回合打出的下一個公主或皇后角色少支付 1 ⬡。

name: Ursula - Sea Witch
en:
YOU'RE TOO LATE Whenever this character
quests, chosen opposing character can't ready at
the start of their next turn.
zh: 你太遲了　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色在其下個回合開始時不能準備。

name: Kuzco - Wanted Llama
en:
OK, WHERE AM I? When this character is
banished, you may draw a card.
zh: 好吧，我在哪？　當這個角色被消滅時，你可以抽一張牌。

name: Elsa - Snow Queen
en: FREEZE ⟳ — Exert chosen opposing character.
zh: 冰凍　⟳ — 橫置指定的對方角色。

name: Goofy - Set for Adventure
en:
FAMILY VACATION Once during your turn,
whenever this character moves to a location, you
may move one of your other characters to that
location for free. If you do, draw a card.
zh: 家庭度假　你回合中一次，每當這個角色移動到一個地點時，你可以將你另一個角色免費移動到該地點。若你這麼做，抽一張牌。

name: Pegasus - Gift for Hercules
en:
Evasive (Only characters with Evasive can
challenge this character.)
zh: 迴避（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰這個角色。）

name: Stand Out
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gets +3 ¤ and gains Evasive until
the start of your next turn. (Only characters with
Evasive can challenge them.)
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色獲得 +3 ¤ 並獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。（只有具迴避的角色能挑戰他們。）

name: Max Goof - Rockin' Teen
en:
Singer 5 (This character counts as cost 5 to
sing songs.)
I JUST WANNA STAY HOME This character can't
move to locations.
zh:
歌手 5（這個角色視為費用 5 來詠唱歌曲。）
我只想待在家　這個角色不能移動到地點。

name: Powerline - Musical Superstar
en:
ELECTRIC MOVE If you've played a song this turn,
this character gains Rush this turn. (They can
challenge the turn they're played.)
zh: 電力舞步　若你本回合打出過一首歌，這個角色本回合獲得突襲。（他們在被打出的回合就能挑戰。）

name: Be King Undisputed
en:
(A character with cost 4 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Each opponent chooses and banishes one of their
characters.
zh:
（費用 4 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
每位對手選擇並消滅其一個角色。

name: Alice - Accidentally Adrift
en:
WASHED AWAY When you play this character,
you may put chosen item into its player's inkwell
facedown and exerted.
MAKING WAVES Whenever this character quests,
chosen opposing character gets -2 ¤ this turn.
zh:
沖走　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將指定的物品牌面朝下並橫置放入其持有者的墨水池。
興風作浪　每當這個角色探險時，指定的對方角色本回合獲得 -2 ¤。

name: Anna - Braving the Storm
en:
I WAS BORN READY While you have another Hero
character in play, this character gets +1 ◊.
zh: 我天生就準備好了　當你另有一個英雄角色在場時，這個角色獲得 +1 ◊。

name: The Queen - Mirror Seeker
en:
CALCULATING AND VAIN Whenever this character
quests, you may look at the top 3 cards of your
deck and put them back in any order.
zh: 精於算計又虛榮　每當這個角色探險時，你可以查看你牌庫頂 3 張卡並以任意順序放回。

name: Robin Hood - Capable Fighter
en:
SKIRMISH ⟳ — Deal 1 damage to chosen
character.
zh: 小衝突　⟳ — 對指定角色造成 1 點傷害。

name: Mickey Mouse - Standard Bearer
en:
STAND STRONG When you play this character,
chosen character gains Challenger +2 this turn.
(They get +2 ¤ while challenging.)
zh: 堅定站立　當你打出這個角色時，指定角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。（他們挑戰時獲得 +2 ¤。）

name: One Last Hope
en:
(A character with cost 3 or more can ⟳ to sing this
song for free.)
Chosen character gains Resist +2 until the start of your
next turn. If a Hero character is chosen, they can also
challenge ready characters this turn. (Damage dealt to
them is reduced by 2.)
zh:
（費用 3 或以上的角色可以橫置來免費詠唱這首歌。）
指定角色獲得抵抗 +2，直到你的下個回合開始。若選擇的是英雄角色，他們本回合還可以挑戰已準備的角色。（對他們造成的傷害減少 2。）

name: Pongo - Determined Father
en:
TWILIGHT BARK Once during your turn, you may
pay 2 ⬡ to reveal the top card of your deck.
If it's a character card, put it into your hand.
Otherwise, put it on the bottom of your deck.
zh: 暮光犬吠　你回合中一次，你可以支付 2 ⬡ 展示你牌庫頂的卡。若它是角色卡，將它加入手牌；否則，將它放到你牌庫底。

name: Beast - Gracious Prince
en:
FULL DANCE CARD Your Princess characters
get +1 ¤ and +1 ⛉.
zh: 滿滿的舞會邀約　你的公主角色獲得 +1 ¤ 和 +1 ⛉。

name: Circle of Life
en:
Sing Together 8
Play a character from your discard for free.
zh:
合唱 8
從你的棄牌堆免費打出一個角色。

name: Belle - Accomplished Mystic
en:
Shift 3 ⬡
ENHANCED HEALING When you play this
character, move up to 3 damage counters
from chosen character to chosen opposing
character.
zh:
變身 3 ⬡
強化治療　當你打出這個角色時，將至多 3 個傷害指示物從指定角色移到指定的對方角色。

name: Dumbo - Ninth Wonder of the Universe
en:
Evasive
BREAKING RECORDS ⟳, 1 ⬡ — Draw a card and gain
1 lore.
MAKING HISTORY Your other characters with Evasive
gain “⟳, 1 ⬡ — Draw a card and gain 1 lore.”
zh:
迴避
打破紀錄　⟳，1 ⬡ — 抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值。
創造歷史　你其他具迴避的角色獲得「⟳，1 ⬡ — 抽一張牌並獲得 1 點傳說值」。

name: Genie - Of the Lamp
en:
Evasive
LET'S MAKE SOME MAGIC While this character
is exerted, your other characters get +2 ¤.
zh:
迴避
來變點魔法　當這個角色橫置時，你其他的角色獲得 +2 ¤。

name: Max Goof - Chart Topper
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
NUMBER ONE HIT Whenever this character
quests, you may play a song card with cost 4 or
less from your discard for free, then put it on the
bottom of your deck instead of into your discard.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
冠軍金曲　每當這個角色探險時，你可以從你的棄牌堆免費打出一張費用 4 或以下的歌曲卡，然後將它放到你牌庫底而非棄牌堆。

name: Ariel - Adventurous Collector
en:
Evasive
INSPIRING VOICE Whenever you play a song,
chosen character of yours gains Evasive until
the start of your next turn.
zh:
迴避
激勵之聲　每當你打出一首歌時，你一個指定角色獲得迴避，直到你的下個回合開始。

name: Powerline - World's Greatest Rock Star
en:
Shift 4 ⬡
Singer 9
MASH-UP Once during your turn, whenever this
character sings a song, look at the top 4 cards of your
deck. You may reveal a song card with cost 9 or less and
play it for free. Put the rest on the bottom of your deck in
any order.
zh:
變身 4 ⬡
歌手 9
混搭　你回合中一次，每當這個角色詠唱一首歌時，查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張費用 9 或以下的歌曲卡並免費打出它。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: I2I
en:
Sing Together 9
Each player draws 2 cards and gains 2 lore. If 2 or
more characters sang this song, ready them. They
can't quest for the rest of this turn.
zh:
合唱 9
每位玩家抽兩張牌並獲得 2 點傳說值。若有 2 個或以上的角色詠唱了這首歌，準備他們。他們本回合剩餘時間內不能探險。

name: Mulan - Considerate Diplomat
en:
IMPERIAL INVITATION Whenever this
character quests, look at the top 4 cards of
your deck. You may reveal a Princess character
card and put it into your hand. Put the rest on
the bottom of your deck in any order.
zh: 皇家邀請　每當這個角色探險時，查看你牌庫頂 4 張卡。你可以展示一張公主角色卡並加入手牌。將其餘的以任意順序放到你牌庫底。

name: Cruella De Vil - Style Icon
en:
OUT OF SEASON Once during your turn,
whenever a character with cost 2 or less is
banished, put the top card of your deck into your
inkwell facedown and exerted.
INSULTING REMARK During your turn, each
opposing character with cost 2 or less gets -1 ¤.
zh:
過季　你回合中一次，每當有一個費用 2 或以下的角色被消滅時，將你牌庫頂的卡牌面朝下並橫置放入你的墨水池。
侮辱性言論　在你的回合中，每個費用 2 或以下的對方角色獲得 -1 ¤。

name: Hades - Infernal Schemer
en:
IS THERE A DOWNSIDE TO THIS? When you play
this character, you may put chosen opposing
character into their player's inkwell facedown.
zh: 這有什麼壞處嗎？　當你打出這個角色時，你可以將指定的對方角色牌面朝下放入其持有者的墨水池。

name: Lilo - Best Explorer Ever
en:
COME ON, PEOPLE, LET'S MOVE When you play this
character, your other characters gain Challenger +2
this turn.
GO GET 'EM Whenever this character quests, chosen
Alien character gains Challenger +2 and “This
character can challenge ready characters” this turn.
zh:
走吧，大家，我們出發　當你打出這個角色時，你其他的角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2。
上吧　每當這個角色探險時，指定的 Alien 角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +2 和「這個角色可以挑戰已準備的角色」。

name: Scar - Finally King
en:
BE GRATEFUL Your Ally characters get +1 ¤.
STICK WITH ME At the end of your turn, if this
character is exerted, you may draw cards equal
to the ¤ of chosen Ally character of yours.
If you do, choose and discard 2 cards and banish
that character.
zh:
心懷感激　你的盟友角色獲得 +1 ¤。
跟緊我　在你的回合結束時，若這個角色橫置，你可以抽取等同你一個指定盟友角色 ¤ 的牌。若你這麼做，選擇並棄掉 2 張卡並消滅該角色。

name: Jasmine - Fearless Princess
en:
TAKE THE LEAP During your turn, this
character gains Evasive.
NOW'S MY CHANCE Choose and discard a card —
This character gains Challenger +3 this turn.
zh:
縱身一躍　在你的回合中，這個角色獲得迴避。
機會來了　選擇並棄掉一張卡 — 這個角色本回合獲得挑戰者 +3。

name: Minnie Mouse - Sweetheart Princess
en:
ROYAL FAVOR Your characters named Mickey Mouse
gain Support.
BYE BYE, NOW Whenever this character quests, you
may banish chosen exerted character with 5 ¤ or more.
zh:
皇家寵愛　你名為 Mickey Mouse 的角色獲得支援。
再見囉　每當這個角色探險時，你可以消滅一個 5 ¤ 或以上的指定橫置角色。

name: Mickey Mouse - Brave Little Prince
en:
Shift 5 ⬡
Evasive
CROWNING ACHIEVEMENT While this character
has a card under him, he gets +3 ¤, +3 ⛉, and +3 ◊.
zh:
變身 5 ⬡
迴避
加冕成就　當這個角色下方有卡時，他獲得 +3 ¤、+3 ⛉ 和 +3 ◊。
